title: SeaExam and SeaBench: Benchmarking LLMs with Local Multilingual Questions in Southeast Asia

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM performance and semantic embedding distributions on native Southeast Asian benchmarks (SeaExam, SeaBench) versus English-translated benchmarks (MMLU, MT-bench) to reveal Western-centric content biases, as well as evaluating model safety in avoiding culturally sensitive or discriminative statements specific to local SEA contexts.

Evaluating LLM instruction-following and knowledge retention capabilities using natively crafted prompts in Southeast Asian languages (Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese) to measure the performance gap between primary languages (e.g., English) and lower-resource regional languages.
